description: Four `planPrompt` strings inside the new `plans/overview-data.js` still instruct future agents to edit the now-deleted `plans/overview.html` roadmap-data JSON block. Specifically: line 505 `happy-upstream-sync` planPrompt ('bump the lastRanAt timestamp ... in plans/overview.html's roadmap-data JSON to today's date'); line 518 `codex-upstream-rebase` planPrompt ('bump the lastRanAt timestamp ... in plans/overview.html's roadmap-data JSON'); line 531 `agent-view-research` planPrompt ('Add new task entries to plans/parallel-assignments.md and plans/overview.html roadmap-data JSON for each follow-up'); line 658 `roadmap-plugin` planPrompt ('Writes a new <details class=\'cmd\'> row in plans/overview.html + new lettered section in plans/parallel-assignments.md + entries in every JSON map' and 'reads/edits plans/overview.html's JSON block'). These prompts are copy-pasted by operators into ralph commands, so they directly reintroduce the editing workflow this group was created to eliminate. Acceptance Criterion 'git grep -n "edit plans/overview.html" ... returns zero hits' is violated within plans/overview-data.js itself, and the parallel `roadmap-data` zero-hit AC is also violated. Codex flagged the same issue independently.
suggestedFix: Rewrite each of the four planPrompt strings to point at `plans/overview-data.js` and the appropriate map/array (`OVERVIEW_DATA.tasks[]`, `OVERVIEW_DATA.runs[]`, `OVERVIEW_DATA.lastTouched[id]`, etc.) instead of `plans/overview.html` and `roadmap-data JSON`. The `roadmap-plugin` prompt also needs to drop the `<details class='cmd'> row` editing direction and replace it with `tasks[]` append semantics. After rewrite, run the AC grep `git grep -n 'roadmap-data\|in plans/overview\.html' -- plans/overview-data.js` and confirm zero hits.
